turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I'd like to view it. Saturday morning?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We have Saturday at eleven. Shall I book that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Actually, hang on, Saturday's no good, I've got the kids. Could I do Monday at eleven instead?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Monday at eleven is booked instead of Saturday. A member of staff will meet you at Elm Road, and you'll get a text with the address and their name.
